summary: Frontend-only deep regression completed on public preview URL. Most navigation, routing, WhatsApp integrations, SEO/JSON-LD, responsive behavior, and Land's End regression checks passed. Two issues remain: homepage section order deviation and a recurring Contact-page console hydration error.

ui_bugs.issue: Homepage includes an extra editorial marquee section between 'Experience Dandeli' and 'Why Destina', breaking the exact requested order.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console repeatedly reports hydration/HTML nesting error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' while rendering destination options in the enquiry form.

action_items: Remove or reposition the editorial marquee so homepage sequence exactly matches: hero → Popular Dandeli Packages → Featured Dandeli Resort → Experience Dandeli → Why Destina → Explore Wayanad → final WhatsApp CTA → footer.
Fix Contact page option rendering path causing '<span> inside <option>' hydration console error; ensure plain text nodes inside <option> elements at runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: Current Home.jsx injects <EditorialMarquee /> between DandeliExperience and WhyDestina; this conflicts with explicit content-order requirement.

Console errors on Contact route indicate invalid option subtree during runtime instrumentation/hydration; this should be resolved before release because requirement explicitly includes console-error checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS: all required routes including legacy redirect query/hash preservation, desktop dropdown behavior (click/Escape/Enter), mobile drawer close on route change, Nature Mist package/times/inclusions/activities/sightseeing/transport note/FAQs, 5 Nature Mist images and uniqueness, WhatsApp numbers/messages across contextual/global flows (+917019540319), Land's End room/price/gallery/meal/FAQ/enquiry behavior, contact form resort-switch logic + validations, footer links/destination list, desktop sticky hide near footer with tab-order removal, mobile CTA footer non-overlap, canonical/OG/meta per route, TravelAgency + NatureMist JSON-LD, sitemap URL/image counts, robots, responsive widths (320/390/768/1024/1440/1920) with no horizontal overflow, and data-testid coverage on tested routes.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (order mismatch): Home.jsx includes EditorialMarquee between DandeliExperience and WhyDestina, introducing an extra section not listed in mandatory homepage order. RCA-2 (console error): On Contact page, runtime output shows a span node nested inside option under form-resort, triggering React hydration/DOM nesting error in console. Repro: open /contact and inspect console logs; error appears immediately.
